description: This file defines classes, constants, and interfaces related to HDMI-CEC source management within a WPEFramework plugin. It includes class declarations for handling HDMI-CEC devices, message processing, frame listening, and plugin lifecycle management. Additionally, it declares various wrapper methods for JSON RPC interaction and event handlers.

classes.name: HdmiCecSourceFrameListener
classes.description: Implements a listener for HDMI-CEC frames, forwarding notifications to a MessageProcessor.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles incoming CEC frames and forwards them.

classes.name: HdmiCecSourceProcessor
classes.description: Processes various HDMI-CEC messages received from a Connection.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overloaded methods to process specific CEC message types.

classes.name: CECDeviceInfo_2
classes.description: Stores information about a CEC device, including address, vendor ID, OSD name, and status flags.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets device info to default values.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates vendor ID or OSD name and indicates if the value has changed.

classes.name: HdmiCecSource
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI-CEC source functionality, including device management, message handling, and RPC interfaces.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for getting HDMI-CEC enabled status.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves status of active HDMI source.

methods.name: sendRemoteKeyPressWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to send remote key press event.
